topic_thesis: Companies are masking pure profit-margin protection as 'inflation adjustments' to hike your bills by up to 13% annually.
strategic_angle: We expose the 'Margin Protection' scam where corporations use the word 'inflation' as a psychological shield to pass their internal inefficiencies onto the consumer, effectively forcing you to fund their quarterly growth targets.
key_statistic: 13% total price hike in 6 months (7-9% Q1 + 3-4% Q2)
target_emotion: Outrage at being manipulated and the urge to audit personal spending
pinned_comment_text: How much has your monthly grocery or service bill jumped this year? Are they blaming 'inflation' while posting record profits? Comment 'GUIDE' to get our breakdown on how to spot these fake price hikes before you pay. 💬👇
